_leia_me: Regras que ensinam a IA a organizar os documentos escaneados. Estrutura criada: <Pasta de clientes>/<País>/<Cliente>/<PREFIXO> - <Serviço>/[subpasta]/<arquivo com o nome original>. Toda empresa recebe todas as pastas de serviço (mesmo vazias). Tudo em inglês. Depois de editar, envie para o GitHub: o servidor aplica sozinho.
regras_gerais: The client is whoever hires the accounting firm: on a supplier invoice it is the BUYER; on a sales invoice it is the SELLER; on a bank statement it is the account holder; on a payslip it is the employer (the company); on a vehicle document (DVLA) it is the registered keeper.
Each document goes to ONE service only: the service where the team will USE it first.
Sales, purchases/expenses, bank statements and wages reports of a VAT-registered client go to VAT.
Company documents that are not VAT, PAYE or Companies House (e.g. vehicle documents, insurance, loans, leases, year-end and Corporation Tax/CT600 papers) go to Limited Company.
Payslips, P60, P45, P11D, payroll reports, PAYE letters and workplace pension go to PAYE.
Personal documents of an individual (income, rental income, interest, personal P60, HMRC letters about Self Assessment or UTR) go to Self Assessment, and the client is the PERSON, not the company.
Documents that stay valid for years (certificate of incorporation, articles, shareholder register, engagement letter, UTR letter, ID and proof of address for AML) go to Permanent Data.
Companies House filings and letters (confirmation statement, change of officers, registered office, strike-off notices) go to Compliance - Companies House.
Country: use the client's country (address, currency, GB/IE/PT VAT number, Brazilian CNPJ/CPF). If unsure between countries, leave pais empty.
Client name: write the full official name as on the document (e.g. 'ARS Car Direct Ltd'). If the client is in the client list, also give its code.

servicos.descricao: Limited company records and year-end: accounts, Corporation Tax/CT600, vehicle documents (DVLA), insurance, loans, leases and other company papers that are not VAT, PAYE or Companies House.
VAT returns (Making Tax Digital): sales, purchases/expenses, bank statements and wages for the period, VAT submission receipts and HMRC VAT letters.
Payroll: payslips, P60, P45, P11D, payroll reports, PAYE letters, workplace pension.
Personal tax return of an individual: income, rental income, interest, dividends, HMRC Self Assessment and UTR letters.
Long-lasting records: certificate of incorporation, articles, shareholders, engagement letter, UTR letter, ID and proof of address (AML).
Companies House filings and letters: confirmation statement, officers, registered office, strike-off notices.
Any document that does not fit the services above.

tipos_documento.descricao: sales invoice or receipt issued by the client
DVLA document: V5C, VTL306, vehicle tax, registration
